title: Khamasit Sacred Taboo Observance
creator: Traditional Religious Guardians
notes: Solemn days of village boundary closure and ritual stillness where agricultural tasks and travel cease to appease natural spirits. Specific esoteric incantations remain restricted.
indigenous_tangkhul_text: Khamasit wui thangli ramwui khamong shimhaida pamching.
Tara kongli luili ot masa, chingri kahai thotna.
Vareli khorumda ngachon kachi, makapha saikora shimanhorali.
english_translation_text: During Khamasit sacred taboo observance, the boundary paths of the village are sealed in stillness.
No field labor, woodcutting, or travel is permitted, as the community rests in solemn prayer.
Petitioning divine guardianship, that pestilence and misfortune may be averted from our realm.
procedural_stages: 1. Declaration of Khamasit by the Awunga and village elders in response to natural omens or seasonal transition.
2. Erection of green leafy branches across village boundary trails to indicate closed village status.
3. Total cessation of agricultural labor, hunting, spinning, and outbound or inbound travel.
4. Observance of hearth cleanliness and reverent quiet within household compounds.
5. Lifting of taboo at dawn following ritual purification and elder prayers.
seasonal_timing: Designated ceremonial taboo days (Access Tier: RESTRICTED for esoteric prayers)
